args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions to address elevated error rate. Prior version v2.3.1 was unhealthy across us-east, us-west, and eu-west with an 18% error rate. Change manager approval was obtained prior to deploy. v2.3.2 is now rolled out in all three regions and verified healthy with a 0.2% error rate.
args.title: checkout-api incident: hotfix v2.3.2 deployed

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Checked status**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate — confirming the hotfix was needed.

2. **Deployed v2.3.2**: Since v2.3.2 had never run healthy in production, the deploy required change-manager approval, which was granted ("Approved. Looks right."). The version rolled out to all three production regions.

3. **Verified health**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.2 across all regions, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV3 incident **INC-0001** recording the v2.3.1 error-rate issue and the v2.3.2 hotfix deployment; the on-call engineer has been paged.
